         <div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-type="page" data-updated-on="1742906727462" id="page-5ce65e8feb39313c6d46e31a"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-12 span-12"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-20d2d7d07ef691626788"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Living your Kitesurfing dream…Kilifi style</h1>
</div>
</div></div><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-2 span-2"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/2e75b06b-a4fd-4b48-817e-b5a62b4cb1cc_1296/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/2e75b06b-a4fd-4b48-817e-b5a62b4cb1cc_1296/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="3f0aecaba7151fa7367c" id="block-3f0aecaba7151fa7367c"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-8 span-8"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-9b68428d3dc4235f06c2"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>SALTY’S KITESURF VILLAGE </strong>IS A SUSTAINABLY AND ETHICALLY RUN ESTABLISHMENT ON BOFA BEACH, KILIFI. </h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">With beautiful tropical waters, calm lagoons and great waves out on the reef our Kitesurf center, beach bar and restaurant is perfect for kite surfers. We cater to all kitesurfing styles, holidays and also provide affordable accommodation to our visiting kite surfers.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">At Salty’s, we believe that an awesome kite surfing holiday is the product of perfect location, yearly reliable winds and all great facilities!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">At our dedicated kite surfing center you can <a href="/kitesurfing" target="_blank">rent kitesurfing equipment </a>or <a href="/kitecenter" target="_blank">book kitesurfing lessons</a> with our dedicated kite surfing team. We also have the best <a href="/saltyscafe" target="_blank">beach bar &amp; restaurant</a><strong> </strong>in Kilifi, accommodation, free WIFI, chill-out areas, equipment cleaning, storage, rescue facilities and of course, great vibes!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">In Kilifi town, only 3km away, you can soak up the local atmosphere during a stroll down the streets, visit the fresh veg market, watch the boats move up and down the creek, hang out with the locals in tea rooms and enjoy local cuisine. </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We can’t wait to see you at our little slice of Kitesurfing paradise! </p>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-2 span-2"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/2e75b06b-a4fd-4b48-817e-b5a62b4cb1cc_1296/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/2e75b06b-a4fd-4b48-817e-b5a62b4cb1cc_1296/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="ee21fe402d941b112f04" id="block-ee21fe402d941b112f04"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div></div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-video video-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.video/43fd0e73-bee8-49ea-a2c1-b7932a1ba67e_718/website.components.video.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.video/43fd0e73-bee8-49ea-a2c1-b7932a1ba67e_718/34418.js&quot;,&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.video/43fd0e73-bee8-49ea-a2c1-b7932a1ba67e_718/website.components.video.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.video" data-sqsp-block="video" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1565505857692_7847" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1565505857692_7847"><div class="sqs-block-content">
  <div class="intrinsic" style="max-width:100%">
    <div
      class="embed-block-wrapper"
      style="padding-bottom:56.49999999999999%;"
    >
      <div

</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1668067147002_18108"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><br><strong>How to get to us? </strong></h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">You have a choice of 2 International Airports just under 1 hour drive from Kilifi. Vipingo Ridge also works for domestic flights.</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><a href="https://www.kaa.go.ke/airports/our-airports/moi-international-airport/"><span style="text-decoration:underline">Moi International Airport in Mombasa</span></a></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><a href="https://www.kaa.go.ke/airports/our-airports/malindi-airport/"><span style="text-decoration:underline">Malindi International Airport</span></a></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><a href="https://www.flysafarilink.com/Destinations/Flights_To_Vipingo_Ridge"><span style="text-decoration:underline">Vipingo Ridge Airport</span></a></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Salty’s is on Bofa Beach, one of the most picturesque locations in the coastal town of Kilifi, where the conditions are perfect for learning and enjoying any watersport. We provide the most convenient accommodation for our unique kitesurfing spot. If you require an airport pick up please give us your flight number, number of passengers, and arrival time in the “Message“ section of our <a href="https://saltyskitesurfvillage.stay.at" target="_blank"><strong>Booking Page</strong></a>.</p></li></ul>
</div>
